title: Generation-consumption-transmission information-gap register
purpose: Make missing evidence visible so the dashboard never fills a gap with an inference disguised as a measurement.

priority_meaning.P0: blocks a central comparison or can materially mislead
priority_meaning.P1: important for planning or contextual interpretation

gaps.gap: Unified hourly load projections by BA, zone, or bus through 2050-2070
gaps.why_it_matters: Annual TWh does not establish peak MW, ramping, weather coincidence, or which corridor is needed.
gaps.current_evidence: 2024 EIA-930 hourly history; NERC ten-year seasonal peaks; AEO annual national scenarios.
gaps.recommended_path: Acquire public ISO/RTO and utility load-forecast cases; create weather-normalized load-shape synthesis with transparent end-use models. Do not fabricate hourly data from annual totals.
gaps.dashboard_treatment: Visible gap card; keep historical hourly and long-run annual panels separate.

gaps.gap: Public, machine-readable line and interface ratings with seasonal, directional, outage, and contingency context
gaps.why_it_matters: Voltage and project nameplate are not usable transfer capability.
gaps.current_evidence: HIFLD public geometry plus a small curated set of official project and operator ratings.
gaps.recommended_path: Ingest ISO/RTO planning tables and OASIS interface data region by region; publish only non-CEII aggregates.
gaps.dashboard_treatment: Typed capacity fields; unknown remains null.

gaps.gap: Current national project inventory with stable IDs, route geometry, milestone dates, costs, status, and cancellation history
gaps.why_it_matters: Announcements and permits are often mistaken for operating capacity, while route and scope change over time.
gaps.current_evidence: Curated major-corridor catalog and HIFLD base layer.
gaps.recommended_path: Build a versioned project registry from FERC, DOE, state commissions, ISO/RTO plans, and developer filings with status evidence dates.
gaps.dashboard_treatment: Status timeline with operating, construction, permitted, proposed, suspended, and canceled as mutually exclusive dated states.

gaps.gap: Distribution topology, hosting capacity, feeder/substation constraints, and transformer inventory
gaps.why_it_matters: EVs, heat pumps, rooftop solar, batteries, and data centers often bind at distribution or subtransmission assets before bulk generation does.
gaps.current_evidence: National aggregate transformer reports; no public unified substation inventory.
gaps.recommended_path: Ingest utility hosting-capacity maps and public distribution plans; maintain aggregate security rules and avoid sensitive asset disclosure.
gaps.dashboard_treatment: Coverage map that distinguishes public, aggregated, restricted, and missing data.

gaps.gap: Deduplicated large-load and data-center interconnection queue with probability, timing, site, power quality, backup, and flexibility
gaps.why_it_matters: Announced requests can be speculative or duplicated, but omitting them understates local capacity and transformer needs.
gaps.current_evidence: National data-center electricity scenarios and NERC assessment-level load growth.
gaps.recommended_path: Join ISO/RTO, utility, state economic-development, permit, land, and corporate filings; assign confidence tiers and never sum raw announcements.
gaps.dashboard_treatment: Pipeline funnel: announced, study, contract, equipment ordered, construction, energized, canceled.

gaps.gap: Geographic EV charging load shapes under managed and unmanaged charging
gaps.why_it_matters: The same annual EV TWh can have very different feeder and system peaks.
gaps.current_evidence: National historical/annual EV energy and scenario endpoints; no unified local hourly series.
gaps.recommended_path: Combine vehicle registrations, travel survey profiles, charger inventory, tariffs, managed-charging trials, temperature effects, and adoption scenarios.
gaps.dashboard_treatment: Scenario fan by geography and charger class; mark EV load as contained in total demand.

gaps.gap: Scenario harmonization across AEO, NREL, NGFS, DOE transmission studies, NERC, and ISO/RTO forecasts
gaps.why_it_matters: Different policies, weather years, geographic boundaries, end-use accounting, and model vintages cannot be combined as one trajectory.
gaps.current_evidence: Separate scenario catalogs and boundary documentation.
gaps.recommended_path: Create a scenario ontology with policy, technology cost, demand, fuel price, climate, geography, time resolution, and model lineage fields.
gaps.dashboard_treatment: Faceted comparison; default to within-family ranges and explicit cross-family warnings.

gaps.gap: Generation-to-network locational linkage and realistic interconnection deliverability
gaps.why_it_matters: National generation capacity does not show whether output can reach load or satisfy resource adequacy.
gaps.current_evidence: Plant/generator data and national/regional transmission studies are not yet joined at a stable network node.
gaps.recommended_path: Join EIA-860/923, queue records, public bus/zone mappings, transmission upgrades, and commercial-operation milestones with confidence-rated geocoding.
gaps.dashboard_treatment: Plant-to-zone links with deliverability status; no implied line-level injection when only county coordinates exist.

gaps.gap: Common weather and climate stress years across load, renewable output, thermal derates, hydrology, wildfire, and outages
gaps.why_it_matters: Reliability depends on coincident events; separate average datasets hide compound stress.
gaps.current_evidence: Historical load shape and scenario averages; no common project-wide weather ensemble.
gaps.recommended_path: Define historical and climate-adjusted weather-year ensembles; compute load and resource profiles from the same timestamps and preserve model uncertainty.
gaps.dashboard_treatment: Stress-event explorer, not one typical-year line.

gaps.gap: Current transformer, breaker, switchgear, cable, conductor, and HVDC converter order books and lead times
gaps.why_it_matters: Shared equipment can delay generation, transmission, data centers, and electrification simultaneously.
gaps.current_evidence: DOE and GAO structural assessments; no authoritative public national order book.
gaps.recommended_path: Collect anonymized quarterly utility and manufacturer surveys by product class and specification band; separate quote, order, factory slot, delivery, and commissioning dates.
gaps.dashboard_treatment: Show only sourced distributions by product class and observation date; never recycle a 2022 lead time as current.

gaps.gap: Operating qualified manufacturing capacity versus announced factory capacity
gaps.why_it_matters: Announcements, awards, construction, qualification, ramp, and actual output are different states.
gaps.current_evidence: Technology deep dives and government project announcements.
gaps.recommended_path: Facility registry with product, specification, nameplate, actual output, qualification, start date, ownership, funding, and source confidence.
gaps.dashboard_treatment: Factory pipeline waterfall, never a single summed 'domestic capacity' number.

gaps.gap: Scenario-consistent critical-material demand and supply by technology and chemistry
gaps.why_it_matters: Battery, wind, solar, grid, nuclear, and hydrogen scenarios can compete for copper, electrical steel, lithium, graphite, rare earths, and specialized catalysts.
gaps.current_evidence: Technology-specific qualitative maps; no linked project scenario material balance.
gaps.recommended_path: Apply source-specific material-intensity ranges to capacity scenarios with recycling, substitution, yield, and geography; retain uncertainty and avoid fixed coefficients across decades.
gaps.dashboard_treatment: Material demand bands by scenario with supply pipeline and recycling overlays.

gaps.gap: Behind-the-meter solar, storage, backup generation, and flexible-load visibility
gaps.why_it_matters: Metered grid demand is net of some customer resources and can move differently from gross consumption.
gaps.recommended_path: Combine EIA, state interconnection, utility AMI studies, and survey estimates with explicit gross/net accounting.
gaps.dashboard_treatment: Waterfall from gross end use to onsite generation, charging, exports, and grid demand.

gaps.gap: Time-varying capacity credit and effective load-carrying capability by region
gaps.why_it_matters: Nameplate MW cannot be compared directly across variable renewables, storage durations, thermal units, imports, and demand response.
gaps.recommended_path: Ingest accredited-capacity and ELCC results from each ISO/RTO and document method, season, vintage, and portfolio dependence.
gaps.dashboard_treatment: Nameplate and accredited capacity as separate nonstacked metrics.

gaps.gap: Hourly forced outages, derates, fuel limitations, and maintenance by technology
gaps.why_it_matters: Installed capacity and annual generation hide availability during peaks and extreme events.
gaps.recommended_path: Use public ISO/RTO outage aggregates, NERC GADS where licensable, EIA fuel data, and weather-event reports; do not publish sensitive unit-level details.

gaps.gap: Hourly losses, congestion, curtailment, and marginal transmission value on consistent national geography
gaps.why_it_matters: A small share of hours can drive large benefits, but ISO/RTO definitions and market designs differ.
gaps.recommended_path: Build operator-specific adapters for LMP congestion components, shadow prices, curtailment, and loss factors; aggregate only after semantic reconciliation.

gaps.gap: Who pays and who benefits from each transmission project
gaps.why_it_matters: Regional reliability, generator access, local land burden, and retail bill impacts fall on different groups.
gaps.recommended_path: Normalize cost allocation, revenue requirement, participant funding, contracts, tax benefits, community benefits, and modeled production-cost savings by payer and beneficiary.

gaps.gap: Empirical project duration by milestone and reason for delay
gaps.why_it_matters: A single average hides routing, litigation, procurement, financing, and construction bottlenecks.
gaps.current_evidence: Case studies and current project pages, not a comprehensive database.
gaps.recommended_path: Versioned milestone event log from proposal through operation/cancellation with pause and litigation flags.

gaps.gap: Project-level health and air-quality changes attributable to enabled dispatch
gaps.why_it_matters: Transmission health benefits depend on which generators run less or more and where people are exposed.
gaps.recommended_path: Link scenario dispatch to emissions, reduced-complexity air-quality models, demographic exposure, uncertainty, and baseline year.
gaps.dashboard_treatment: Never assign a generic health benefit per mile of line.

gaps.gap: Watershed-resolved water withdrawal, consumption, thermal discharge, hydropower, cooling, hydrogen, and data-center coupling
gaps.why_it_matters: National averages hide local scarcity and seasonal competition.
gaps.recommended_path: Join EIA plant cooling, USGS water use, hydrology and drought, watershed boundaries, data-center cooling design, and scenario operations on consistent time and space.

gaps.gap: Climate-adjusted line, transformer, substation, and wildfire vulnerability
gaps.why_it_matters: Ambient heat reduces equipment ratings; wildfire, flood, ice, wind, and sea-level hazards alter failure and maintenance risk.
gaps.recommended_path: Combine public asset aggregates with climate hazard layers and engineering vulnerability functions; protect CEII.

gaps.gap: Digital component provenance, firmware vulnerability, and supplier concentration
gaps.why_it_matters: Inverters, relays, sensors, chargers, data centers, and grid controls share opaque digital supply chains.
gaps.recommended_path: Publish aggregate vendor-concentration and lifecycle-management indicators; keep exploitable asset detail restricted.

gaps.gap: Workforce pipeline by occupation, certification, region, retirement, training time, and project demand
gaps.why_it_matters: Lineworkers, electricians, planners, protection engineers, transformer winders/testers, welders, nuclear QA staff, and heavy-haul specialists are not interchangeable.
gaps.recommended_path: Combine BLS, apprenticeship, licensing, union, employer, and project labor estimates by detailed occupation.

gaps.gap: End-of-life volumes, reuse, recycling yield, and destination for grid and generation equipment
gaps.why_it_matters: Retirements can return copper, aluminum, steel, battery materials, and components, but recovery timing and quality are uncertain.
gaps.recommended_path: Stock-and-flow model by installation vintage, lifetime distribution, reuse eligibility, collection, recovery yield, and processing location.

gaps.gap: Cross-border imports with hourly source mix, contractual firmness, hydrology, and environmental accounting
gaps.why_it_matters: An import corridor's MW rating does not reveal annual energy, winter availability, capacity accreditation, or generation impacts abroad.
gaps.recommended_path: Join EIA-930 interchange, Canadian operator data, contracts, water/hydrology, certificates, and system-operator capacity treatment.

gaps.gap: Public validation of approximate corridor geometry
gaps.why_it_matters: Schematic waypoints are adequate for a national overview but not local impact analysis.
gaps.recommended_path: Replace approximate paths with official developer or agency GIS where licensing permits; retain geometry source and resolution.

gaps.gap: Heat-pump and electrified-building load shapes by climate zone and building stock
gaps.why_it_matters: Cold-climate peak and backup-heat assumptions can dominate winter demand.
gaps.recommended_path: Use building-stock models, AMI studies, equipment performance, envelope retrofits, and weather ensembles.

gaps.gap: Commercialization pathways for marine, enhanced geothermal, advanced nuclear, long-duration storage, and other emerging technologies
gaps.why_it_matters: Resource potential and demonstration capacity are often mistaken for commercial generation.
gaps.recommended_path: Track technology-readiness level, demonstration, order, financing, construction, qualification, and operation separately.

gaps.gap: Consistent uncertainty distributions rather than point forecasts
gaps.why_it_matters: Data-center growth, fuel prices, policies, technology cost, weather, and construction timing are deeply uncertain.
gaps.recommended_path: Retain source scenario ensembles and quantified ranges; do not average incompatible scenarios into a false central case.

gaps.gap: Automated source-vintage, link, checksum, and claim-evidence monitoring
gaps.why_it_matters: Project status, draft studies, compliance schedules, and forecasts change after publication.
gaps.recommended_path: Build scheduled link checks and content hashes; route material changes to human claim review before dashboard publication.
gaps.dashboard_treatment: Every metric shows source vintage, accessed date, and verification status.
